supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s find the area of more rectangles.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Describe and represent the area of a rectangle as the total number of unit squares arranged in equal groups of rows and columns. Find the area of rectangles (within 60 square units) by counting unit squares.
teachingSteps: Identify unit squares and the area being measured.
Represent the shape or rectangle with equal-area units.
Calculate or compare area with units and check any decomposition.
